candidate_evidence.quote: In this study we use Visudyne by itself like chemotherapy to kill tumor cells which may be sensitive to verteporfin.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Verteporfin for the Treatment of Recurrent High Grade EGFR-Mutated Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To describe pharmacokinetics of Visudyne administered on a weekly schedule.

role_evidence.quote: In this study we use Visudyne by itself like chemotherapy to kill tumor cells which may be sensitive to verteporfin.
Treatment (verteporfin): Patients receive verteporfin IV over 83 minutes weekly for 6 weeks in cycle 1

agents.drug_class_hint: liposomal verteporfin (Visudyne), photosensitiser used here without light
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: used by itself like chemotherapy to kill tumor cells

source_quote.quote: Eligible participants have tumors that show mutant or amplified EGFR.

flag.reason: EGFR mutation/amplification is an entry requirement and is in the title, but the record states no mechanistic link between EGFR and verteporfin (not an EGFR inhibitor).

coder_notes: Bevacizumab may be continued by participants already on it but is not a registered intervention and not given to every patient, so not listed. PK sample type is not stated (only 'pharmacokinetics of Visudyne'), hence unclear.
